verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a feature where users describe what should happen to their files and an AI model carries it out, which is natural-language operation of the product. It also lets users drive its file tools from ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients. Both come only from one-line entries in the llms.txt index, so the depth is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the AI feature's scope and limits, examples of supported natural-language commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what should happen with your files, and an AI model takes care of it.
Use CloudConvert file processing tools from ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP clients.
